comparison: Native monument loop processes indices 1 through 49 at stride 0x90. It selects type 12, type 11, and all-other winners by signed 16-bit value, then higher tie byte; the typed C loop and output IDs match for monument_count=50.

Native copies current-player personal savings, writes each winner value/tie/result ID, selects text group 0x133, and checks byte 6 for '1'. Typed C performs the same updates through explicit state and text-selection operation inputs.

On the text flag, native scans active building indices 1 through 3999 at stride 0x108 and writes the same type 0xde, 0xe1, 0xe4, 0xe5, 0xea, and 0xeb fields. Typed C matches for building_count=4000, including parent-relative type 0xe4 coordinates.
Native obtains the profile path at 0x00516A20 and saves through 0x0041B8A0; typed C represents these as the save_profile operation.
known_limitations: The native entrypoint uses globals and has no arguments; the C owner is a typed helper and no clean C call site currently binds it to this native entrypoint.
Native text selection reads tombRobberWarningTextId at 0x00E38EA8; equivalence to the C settings->mission_id field and its host binding remain unverified.
The host must bind the native arrays and exact 50/4000 loop bounds, text-select operation, and profile-save operation.

verification.call_graph_coverage: 2 direct callers and 3 direct callees; no indirect calls reported
